task: #2113 independent, read-only UV and color-bake conflict audit of the v2 apple source copy.
scope: Fruit primitive only: it carries TEXCOORD_0 and COLOR_0. Stem and leaf are separate meshes/materials and have no UV attribute. No GLB or image was edited.

interiorOverlapAudit.method: 64x64 UV AABB spatial bins generate candidate pairs; convex triangle clipping computes actual intersection polygon area for every candidate pair, including pairs sharing mesh vertex indices.
interiorOverlapAudit.conclusion: No positive-area UV triangle interior overlap was found, including across shared-index pairs. No competing COLOR_0 values need to occupy the same texel interior; bake to baseColorTexture can retain the existing UVs.

seamColorContinuity.positionGrouping: round object-space positions to 1e-7 m cells
seamColorContinuity.evidence: All sampled coincident-position UV seam groups have identical COLOR_0 values; no seam-side color conflict was found.

bakeConstraint: Keep POSITION, NORMAL, TEXCOORD_0, indices and node transforms byte/value-identical; bake only COLOR_0 appearance into the baseColorTexture. Since no UV interior overlaps were found, no UV-changing workaround is indicated. Add conventional edge padding/dilation during raster bake to reduce filtering bleed; this does not alter UVs or geometry.
limits: Source-side audit only; a future baked GLB still needs byte/value equivalence checks for geometry, UVs and indices, plus image inspection and seam/pool preview QA.
